We are a deep-tech company that creates and produces internationally awarded smart glasses. Our headquarters is in Vienna, where we develop and manufacture both the hardware and the software of the smart glasses.

From research & development, engineering, production to marketing and sales - we offer everything from a single source under one roof. This will give you exciting insights into other departments of the company. Although we have our roots in Austria, we are "born global" and work with customers and sales partners all over the world.

Making Future Reality together - are you in? 1 Assembly Technician (m/f/x) - The Craft Hand Vienna 1010, fulltime

We build award-winning smart glasses in Vienna: hardware, firmware, software, all under one roof. Behind every device that ships is precise, careful, hands-on work, and that's exactly what this role is about. You'll be part of the team that turns components into finished products, working closely with engineers, quality assurance, and production to keep things moving and the standards high.

This is a role where your hands-on skill and attention to detail make a visible difference every single day.

Tasks

What You'll Be Doing

 * Hands-on assembly of components and devices across different stages of the production process

 * Material preparation, pre-assembly, cleaning, packaging, and warehouse support

 * Use hand and power tools to assemble products with precision and care

 * Inspect components and assemblies to ensure quality standards are met

 * Document and report any discrepancies in the assembly process

 * Collaborate with team members to meet production deadlines

 * Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives on the production floor

Requirements

What You Bring to the Team

 * Completed technical apprenticeship, ongoing or recently completed HTL, or relevant studies

 * Solid technical understanding and careful handling of small components and electronics

 * Manual dexterity and good hand-eye coordination

 * Familiarity with assembly processes, tools, and techniques

 * Attention to detail and a practical problem-solving mindset

 * Flexibility to support a wide range of tasks in production

 * Willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies

 * Good communication skills in German and/or English

Benefits

What's extra?

 * Salary: €2.400 - €4.000 gross/month depending on experience

 * Yearly public transport card (Vienna)

 * "Inspire Days" - time to learn and recharge

 * A front-row seat to how a deep-tech hardware product gets built, from PCB to shipped device

 * International team where your impact is visible every day

Ready to be part of the team that makes smart glasses real?

We can't wait to meet you.

Making Future Reality - let's assemble it together.

Send us your application and let's take off together!

1 Principal Engineer Low Voltage Technology Development (f/m/div) #WeAreIn for jobs that impact everyone's life. 

Join the thinkers, builders, and problem-solvers behind tomorrow's technology. As a Principal Engineer Low Voltage Technology Development in our Research & Development team, you'll have the opportunity to merge creativity with your technical expertise by shaping the future of technology, driving groundbreaking projects, and bringing new ideas to life.

 

Are you in?

Your role
Key responsibilities in your new role

 * Lead technology development and innovation projects in the field of Power MOSFETs with decisive impact for Infineon
 * Drive innovation from the device concept definition, process work-route creation and validation till mass production release
 * Take ownership of designing novel device and process concepts, including cost estimations and decision matrices
 * Collaborate with diverse functions to plan, run and evaluate experiments in the clean room
 * Drive necessary reliability investigations and electrical characterization, application tests to validate the performance and the robustness of the product
 * Ensure process stability, quality, optimize cost of the manufacturing route for the mass-production release

Your profile
Qualifications and skills to help you succeed 

 * A university degree (Master, PhD) in Physics, Electrical Engineering or Material Sciences
 * 5+ years of experience in the field of semiconductor device/process integration covering device physics, cleanroom operations, unit process modules, DOEs, electrical characterization, reliability, failure analysis and IP generation
 * Proven experience in leading multi-site, cross-functional teams in technology development
 * Demonstrated track record of managing technology development projects with a Project Management Certification as strong advantage 
 * Strong leadership and interpersonal skills (coaching, decisive decision-making, negotiation, conflict resolution), with a strategic, resilient, and innovative mindset
 * Excellent planning, problem-solving, and communication/presentation abilities
 * Fluent English communication skills, basic German or willingness to learn is preferred

We offer competitive salaries and additional benefits based on your performance, experience and qualification. The employment is in accordance with the collective salary and wage agreement for employees of the electrical and electronics industry, employment group I (https://www.feei.at/aktuelles/mindestloehne-und-gehaelter-eei/). 1 Postdoctoral Researcher (Quantitative Methods) (m/f/d) Advertisement No. SB26-0125.

Full-time position (40 hours/week), initially limited to two years.

In this position you will

 * Survey leadership
 ** Design and implement online surveys and embedded survey experiments (e.g. vignette and conjoint experiments) in LimeSurvey.
 ** Lead questionnaire development in close consultation with the Principal Investigator (PI).
 ** Coordinate survey implementation across Tunisia, Egypt, and Morocco, including social media-based participant recruitment.
 ** Lead the analysis of survey and experimental data using advanced quantitative methods.
 * Data collection
 ** Oversee the implementation of face-to-face survey in cooperation with a survey company in Morocco.
 ** Ensure high standards of data quality, research ethics compliance and data management throughout the data collection process.
 ** Contribute to and co-manage the coding of de facto (forced) migration policy data.
 * Research
 ** Develop and submit at least two articles to leading international peer-reviewed journals based on the survey data, in co-authorship with the PI.
 ** Contribute to theoretical development within the project and to further publications arising from MixedRivals.
 * Collaboration
 ** Present project findings at international conferences, workshops and other academic events.
 ** Contribute actively to project meetings, workshops, project documentation and grant reporting.
 ** Collaborate closely with an interdisciplinary and international research team.

Your profile

For your application, we require evidence of the following qualifications:

 * Completed PhD in political science, conflict studies, social psychology, or a related social science discipline, preferably with distinction (the PhD degree must be awarded at the latest by 15th of December 2026).
 * Advanced expertise in quantitative methods, including inferential statistics and causal inference.
 * Demonstrated experience in the design, implementation and analysis of online surveys and survey experiments, combined with advanced quantitative skills in R and/or Stata.
 * A strong publication record in international peer-reviewed journals, appropriate to career stage, together with excellent analytical and academic writing skills.
 * Excellent command of English (minimum C1), both written and spoken.
 * Strong organizational, interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to work both independently and collaboratively in an international research team.
 * Willingness to relocate to Austria and work regularly on site at Campus Krems.

In addition, the following criteria are desirable:
 * Previous research on inter-group perceptions, inequalities, (forced) migration and/or violence
 * Knowledge of or experience in North Africa, particularly Morocco
 * Knowledge of de facto migration policies in Africa
 * Experience with LimeSurvey or comparable survey software.
 * Knowledge of qualitative research methods (e.g. interviews) and/or qualitative analysis software such as MAXQDA
 * Programming skills (e.g. Python)
 * Knowledge of French and/or Arabic
 * Previous experience working in international collaborative research projects

We look forward to receiving your compelling online application by 7 October 2026.

The following documents must be submitted:

 * Curriculum Vitae, including publication list and contact details for two or three references
 * Motivation letter clearly explaining how you could contribute to the project tasks and how the position fits with your previous and future research agenda
 * Two writing samples, preferably first-authored peer-reviewed publications or single-authored academic work 
 * A brief description of your previous survey research experience, including the surveys and/or datasets you have worked with and your role in their design, implementation and/or analysis
 * Copies of degrees and transcripts
